note.zh-TW: 三創生活是台北的實體商場，會員制度以台灣為主；官方頁面沒有明文限制其他地區。
note.en: Syntrend is a mall in Taipei and its membership is aimed at Taiwan; the official pages do not state a regional restriction.

label.zh-TW: 三創生活官網：APP 升級 PLUS 活動頁
label.en: Syntrend official site: app upgrade campaign page

title.en: New members get 100 points on registering

text.zh-TW: 需下載 App、完成註冊並填寫完整資料，每帳號限領一份（依官方會員頁）。活動頁列出的期間為 2026-01-01 至 2026-12-31。取自平台分享文案；實際內容以官方公告為準。
text.en: Needs app registration with full profile details; one per account. Campaign page period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. From the share text; official terms prevail.

title.zh-TW: 推薦人成功推薦新會員註冊，可獲贈 50 點
title.en: The referrer gets 50 points when a referred new member registers

text.zh-TW: 這項是給分享推薦碼的人，不是給新會員。取自官方會員中心頁，分享文案沒有提到；實際內容與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: This goes to the person who shares the code, not to the new member. From the official member page, not the share text; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」：本站會先複製推薦碼 yhgw0，再開啟三創生活的 App 下載頁（依裝置轉址；桌面瀏覽器會轉到官網首頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies code yhgw0, then opens the app download redirect page (it redirects by device; desktop lands on the official home page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載並開啟三創生活 PLUS App，開始註冊新會員。
steps.en: Follow the page’s instructions to download and open the 三創生活 PLUS app, then start registering as a new member.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時貼上推薦碼（分享文案稱邀請碼）yhgw0；若沒有貼上，請依原樣手動輸入。App 內的輸入位置官方未公開。
steps.en: Paste code yhgw0 (the share text calls it an invite code) during registration; if nothing is pasted, type it in as shown. The official pages do not say where.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊並填寫完整資料後，確認 100 點是否入帳；條件與期限以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After registering and filling in the full profile, check whether the 100 points arrive; conditions and deadlines follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 三創生活的會員 App；依分享文案，註冊新會員得 100 點，推薦碼 yhgw0；官方頁面沒有寫 100 點需要輸入推薦碼。
intro.en: Share text: new members get 100 points; code yhgw0. Official pages do not tie the points to it.

description.zh-TW:
三創生活 PLUS 是三創生活（台北市的電子與生活購物商場）的會員 App，依官方會員中心頁，提供會員等級、消費集點與折抵、點數兌換和活動資訊等功能。本站的連結不含推薦碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製推薦碼 yhgw0，再開啟三創生活官方網域上的 App 下載轉址頁。

依分享文案，註冊新會員得 100 點；官方會員中心寫明，需下載 App、完成註冊並填寫完整資料。下載並開啟 App 後，註冊時請貼上推薦碼，也可依原樣手動輸入。點數價值、使用條件與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
The 三創生活 PLUS app is the member app of 三創生活 (Syntrend), an electronics and lifestyle shopping mall in Taipei. According to the official member page it offers membership levels, points earned on purchases and used toward spending, point redemption, and event information. The link on this page does not carry the referral code: selecting “Sign up” first copies code yhgw0, then opens the app download redirect page on the official Syntrend domain.

Per the share text, registering as a new member earns 100 points; the official member page says this requires downloading the app, completing registration and filling in full profile details. After downloading and opening the app, paste the code during registration, or type it in exactly as shown. Point values, conditions and deadlines follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
此連結不含推薦碼，註冊時請貼上或手動輸入 yhgw0（依原樣輸入）。分享文案稱「邀請碼」，官方會員頁稱「專屬推薦碼」；App 內欄位的名稱與位置、是否區分大小寫，官方都沒有公開。

官方頁面把 100 點寫成下載並完成註冊的新會員禮，沒有提到需要輸入推薦碼；推薦者另可獲贈 50 點。點數價值、使用條件與期限以官方公告為準，推薦碼是否被接受，本站沒有實際註冊測試。

連結 www.syntrend.com.tw/appplus/TQRCode.html 在三創生活官方網域，是依裝置轉址的 App 下載頁；2026-10-24 以桌面瀏覽器開啟，會轉到官網首頁。行動裝置（iOS、Android）的轉址沒有測試。

依官方會員中心頁，須年滿 16 歲才能申辦會員，未滿 18 歲或限制行為能力者須經法定代理人事前同意。官方防詐聲明提醒，三創生活只認官網 syntrend.com.tw、官方 Facebook 粉絲專頁與 shop.syntrend.com.tw。這組連結與推薦碼來自個人的分享文案，不是三創生活發送的訊息。
notes.en:
This link does not carry the code, so paste it or type yhgw0 in exactly as shown when registering. The share text calls it an invite code (邀請碼), while Syntrend’s official member page calls it a referral code (專屬推薦碼). The official pages do not say what the field is called or where it sits in the app, or whether the code is case-sensitive.

The official pages present the 100 points as a welcome gift for downloading and registering and do not mention entering a code; the referrer separately gets 50 points. Point values, conditions and deadlines follow the official announcements. Nobody registered to test whether the code is accepted.

The link www.syntrend.com.tw/appplus/TQRCode.html is on the official Syntrend domain and is a download redirect page that sends visitors on depending on their device. Opened in a desktop browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to the official home page. The redirect on mobile devices (iOS and Android) was not tested.

Per the official member page, applicants must be at least 16, and those under 18 or with limited legal capacity need their legal representative’s prior consent. Syntrend’s official anti-fraud notice says it recognises only its website syntrend.com.tw, its official Facebook page and shop.syntrend.com.tw. This link and code come from an individual’s share text, not from a message sent by Syntrend.

q.zh-TW: 三創生活 PLUS 的推薦碼 yhgw0 要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the 三創生活 PLUS code yhgw0?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案，推薦碼 yhgw0 要在下載三創生活 PLUS App 後輸入，但沒有說明在哪個畫面；通常是註冊時，這是推測，官方頁面也沒有公開 App 內的輸入位置。本站的連結不含推薦碼，點擊「立即註冊」時會先複製；請貼上，若沒有貼上，請依原樣手動輸入。
a.en: Per the share text, code yhgw0 is entered after downloading the 三創生活 PLUS app; it does not say on which screen, and registration is the likely place but that is an assumption. The official pages do not say where in the app it goes. The link on this site does not carry the code; selecting “Sign up” copies it first. Paste it, or type it in as shown if nothing is pasted.

q.zh-TW: 註冊新會員可以得到什麼？一定要輸入推薦碼嗎？
q.en: What do new members get, and is the code required?

a.zh-TW: 依分享文案，註冊新會員得 100 點。官方會員中心寫明，下載 App、完成註冊並填寫完整資料即贈 100 點，每帳號限領一份，活動頁列出的期間是 2026-01-01 至 2026-12-31；官方頁面把它寫成新會員禮，沒有提到需要輸入推薦碼。推薦者另可獲贈 50 點，官方沒有說明輸入推薦碼的新會員是否另有獎勵。實際內容以官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the share text, registering as a new member earns 100 points. The official member page says to download the app, complete registration and fill in full profile details to receive 100 points, one per account; its campaign page lists the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. The official pages present it as a welcome gift and do not say the code is needed. The referrer separately gets 50 points, and they do not say whether a new member who enters the code gets anything extra; official announcements prevail.
